n287946b05c.headline: Lifezone Metals Upgrades High-Grade Nickel Copper and Cobalt Mineral Resources at its Kabanga Nickel Project
n287946b05c.summary: Lifezone Metals reports a 21% increase in contained nickel in the measured and indicated category at the North Zone of its Kabanga project. Nickel grade rose 3% across all zones.
n287946b05c.why: Nickel is used in stainless steel and battery cathodes, and upgraded resource estimates can support a project's development case.

n4deb85506d.headline: Tax reform bills won't benefit Lagos – Governor Sanwo-Olu
n4deb85506d.summary: Lagos Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu said reports that the controversial tax reform bills would favour Lagos are not true. The bills remain contested in Nigeria.
n4deb85506d.why: Nigeria's tax reform affects revenue sharing between federal and state governments and the tax burden on businesses operating in Africa's largest economy.

nb04ef1e201.headline: Elon Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy take their DOGE government efficiency pitch to the Hill
nb04ef1e201.summary: Elon Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy, leaders of the Department of Government Efficiency, are calling on Congress for large-scale federal layoffs. They also urge eliminating some federal agencies during Trump's second term.
nb04ef1e201.why: Federal workforce and agency changes affect government spending, contractors and regulatory activity that matter to US-focused investors.

n3986cceb94.headline: Greek economic growth to exceed 2% annually in next two years, says OECD
n3986cceb94.summary: The OECD expects Greece's economy to grow by more than 2% annually over the next two years, helped by continuing EU funds flows. It said Greece needs to do more to attract investment.
n3986cceb94.why: The OECD is the Paris-based intergovernmental economic forecaster, and its outlooks guide investor views on European sovereign growth and risk.

n12d7f0a3b9.headline: Lifezone Metals :  Upgrades High Grade Nickel Copper and Cobalt Mineral Resources at its Kabanga Nickel Project Form 6 K
n12d7f0a3b9.summary: Lifezone Metals upgraded high-grade nickel, copper and cobalt mineral resources at Kabanga. Contained nickel in the measured and indicated North Zone rose 21%.
n12d7f0a3b9.why: Lifezone Metals is developing the Kabanga nickel project, and nickel is used in batteries and stainless steel.

n76a19f610a.headline: Bajaj Freedom CNG Price Cut - Customers Benefit By Up To Rs 10K
n76a19f610a.summary: Bajaj has cut prices of the Freedom CNG bike by Rs 5,000 and Rs 10,000 on its base and mid variants respectively. The lower prices make the model more affordable.
n76a19f610a.why: Bajaj Auto is an Indian two-wheeler maker, and pricing moves on its CNG models reflect competition in the country's motorcycle market.

n4f6d5e95e9.headline: Global companies likely to be affected by Trump's promised tariffs
n4f6d5e95e9.summary: President-elect Donald Trump pledged tariffs on Canada, Mexico and China, the United States' three largest trading partners. The plan could trigger trade wars, according to the report.
n4f6d5e95e9.why: Canada, Mexico and China are the largest US trading partners, so tariffs on them affect supply chains and trade flows worldwide. Trade policy shifts are a major driver of global equity and currency moves.

n6f102e93f6.headline: Shell, Norway's Equinor To Form Joint UK Oil And Gas Firm
n6f102e93f6.summary: Shell and Norway's Equinor announced plans to merge their UK offshore oil and gas assets into a new jointly owned company. The deal was announced on Thursday.
n6f102e93f6.why: Shell is a British energy major and Equinor is Norway's state-controlled oil and gas company. Combining offshore assets reshapes ownership of North Sea production.

nf735667b3a.headline: Kenya lifts ban on export of raw macadamia
nf735667b3a.summary: Kenya on Wednesday allowed the sale and export of raw macadamia nuts for 30 days, lifting a ban imposed early last month.
nf735667b3a.why: Kenya is a significant macadamia producer, and export rules affect farmer income and global nut supply.

n58748b8f06.headline: Presidential vote seen as referendum on Romania's European future
n58748b8f06.summary: Romania could elect its first far-right president in a Sunday vote seen as a key test of the EU and NATO member bordering Ukraine.
n58748b8f06.why: Romania is an EU and NATO member, and its political direction affects regional security, EU policy and investor sentiment toward Central and Eastern Europe.

n895744d8fd.headline: Niger seizes control of Somaïr mine
n895744d8fd.summary: Orano said Nigerien authorities have taken operational control of the Somaïr uranium mining company.
n895744d8fd.why: Orano is a French nuclear fuel company, and control of its Niger uranium operations affects global uranium supply and its own output.

n436e25cca6.headline: Chery axes its priciest petrol-powered small SUVs
n436e25cca6.summary: Chery has discontinued the more powerful GT versions of its Omoda 5 small SUV, which were among its priciest petrol-powered small SUVs.
n436e25cca6.why: Chery is a large Chinese carmaker, and its model line-up changes reflect shifts in pricing and demand across its range.

n5aa413956d.headline: 3,100-point rally propels PSX past 108,000 as macroeconomic stability boosts investor mood
n5aa413956d.summary: The KSE-100 index rose nearly 2.98% to settle at 108,238.96, a gain of about 3,100 points, as macroeconomic stability boosted investor mood.
n5aa413956d.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of Pakistan Stock Exchange's largest listed companies, so its moves reflect broad sentiment in Pakistan's equity market.
n5aa413956d.why_moved: Improved macroeconomic stability, as cited in the report, lifted investor sentiment and drove buying on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

n7d464f9291.headline: Shell and Equinor tie-up to create new UK oil and gas producer
n7d464f9291.summary: Shell said no jobs will be lost under the deal, which recognises that the North Sea is no longer the prolific basin it once was.
n7d464f9291.why: Shell is a global oil major and Equinor is a Norwegian state-linked producer, so a combined North Sea business changes ownership of mature UK oil and gas assets.

nf9934e010b.headline: Tanzania Investment Centre surpasses expectations, attracts projects worthy $6.5 billion
nf9934e010b.summary: The Tanzania Investment Centre registered 707 investment projects worth $6.5 billion in the 2023/24 fiscal year. The projects span manufacturing, transportation, services, agriculture, and tourism.
nf9934e010b.why: Foreign and domestic investment registrations signal future capital formation and job creation, which matter for emerging-market growth.

n260baa5605.headline: Cypriot deposit rates among lowest in Eurozone
n260baa5605.summary: Cyprus continues to offer some of the lowest deposit interest rates in the eurozone, according to ECB data. The rate on household time deposits of up to one year fell to 1.76 per cent.
n260baa5605.why: Deposit rates reflect bank pricing and savings returns, and they are tracked by the ECB as part of eurozone monetary transmission.

nf19cb189a1.headline: S&P places Singapore Post on credit watch negative following strategy reset, sale of Australia business
nf19cb189a1.summary: S&P has placed Singapore Post on credit watch negative following a strategy reset and the sale of its Australia business. The agency said the loss of a key earnings pillar adds uncertainty over future earnings.
nf19cb189a1.why: A credit watch placement signals a possible rating change, which affects borrowing costs and bond investors in the issuer.

n4059095d1b.headline: NNPC speaks on blending petrol from Port Harcourt Refinery as prices crash
n4059095d1b.summary: The NNPC chief executive said the refurbished Port Harcourt refinery is blending petroleum products, in a period when petrol prices have crashed.
n4059095d1b.why: NNPC is Nigeria's state oil company, and refinery output affects domestic fuel supply and the country's reliance on imported petrol.

n572430c993.headline: Kenya's Central Bank Cuts Key Lending Rate to 11.25% From 12%
n572430c993.summary: Kenya's central bank slashed its benchmark rate by 75 basis points to 11.25% from 12% as it seeks to revive sluggish growth amid easing inflation.
n572430c993.why: The central bank rate sets the cost of borrowing in Kenya and influences the shilling, bank lending and government debt costs.

nf633d0fe77.headline: PM to resign as France's political crisis deepens
nf633d0fe77.summary: Prime Minister Michel Barnier will quit after a historic no-confidence vote, and the next government will face a deepening political crisis in France.
nf633d0fe77.why: France is the euro area's second-largest economy, and political instability affects government bond spreads, fiscal policy and the outlook for European markets.
nf633d0fe77.why_moved: A historic no-confidence vote forced Prime Minister Michel Barnier to resign, and the next government is expected to face the deepening political crisis.

n2cf6720509.headline: RBI adds 27 tn gold to country
n2cf6720509.summary: Central bank gold buying surged to 60 tonnes in October, led by the Reserve Bank of India, which added 27 tonnes, according to the World Gold Council.
n2cf6720509.why: Central bank gold purchases support bullion demand and reflect reserve diversification away from currencies, a trend closely tracked by gold investors.

n697e99e03e.headline: Steinhoff’s desperate efforts to conceal its financial skeletons have failed as court demands transparency
n697e99e03e.summary: South Africa's Supreme Court of Appeal unanimously ordered release of the Steinhoff forensic report, confirming the public interest override of the Promotion of Access to Information Act.
n697e99e03e.why: Steinhoff is a South African-linked retailer whose 2017 accounting scandal wiped out large shareholder value and remains a governance case for investors.

n11d4afe5e3.headline: Military pensioners shut finance ministry in Abuja over unpaid entitlements
n11d4afe5e3.summary: A coalition of military pensioners shut down the finance ministry in Abuja over unpaid entitlements. The protest concerns payments owed to retired personnel.
n11d4afe5e3.why: Nigeria's finance ministry manages federal budgets and payments, so pension arrears signal fiscal strain and can affect public-sector spending and sentiment toward Nigerian assets.

n576aab933a.headline: NBFC-MFIs likely to see subdued disbursements and a sharp moderation in AUM growth to 0- 5% in FY25
n576aab933a.summary: ICRA predicts subdued growth for NBFC-MFIs in FY25, with assets under management growing only 0-5%. Rising credit costs and borrower rejection rates are cited as reasons.
n576aab933a.why: Non-banking financial company microfinance institutions lend to low-income borrowers in India, and their credit quality shapes lending-sector earnings and funding.

n061048f155.headline: Clothing manufacturers raise concerns over GST rates proposal
n061048f155.summary: The Clothing Manufacturers Association of India has raised concerns over a Group of Ministers proposal that includes significant changes to GST rates for apparel. The proposal is part of a rate-rationalisation review.
n061048f155.why: Goods and services tax rates set the cost and pricing of apparel in India, one of the country's largest labour-intensive manufacturing sectors.

n027940cd10.headline: Ghana’s trade surplus shrinks amidst steady export growth
n027940cd10.summary: Ghana recorded a trade surplus of GH₵3.9 billion in the third quarter of 2024, down from GH₵6.1 billion in the second quarter. Export growth remained steady, according to the Ghana Statistical Service.
n027940cd10.why: Trade balances affect foreign-exchange availability and external financing needs, which shape the cedi and Ghana's sovereign risk.

n18c7b05471.headline: PANDEF celebrates Okonjo-Iweala on second term as WTO DG |
n18c7b05471.summary: Nigeria's PANDEF celebrated Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala's second term as WTO Director-General. The group described her as a leading figure from the Niger-Delta region.
n18c7b05471.why: The World Trade Organization sets global trade rules and mediates trade disputes, so its leadership shapes multilateral trade policy that affects exporters and importers worldwide.

nd52723affa.headline: Sterling ticks higher in third day of gains
nd52723affa.summary: The British pound rose for a third consecutive session, climbing 0.15% to $1.2721. It was recovering from a six-month low hit in late November.
nd52723affa.why: Sterling is the currency of the United Kingdom, and its moves against the dollar affect UK importers, exporters and dollar-denominated investments.

na1ca7c8a8d.headline: F&P Healthcare reaps rewards of two strong halves
na1ca7c8a8d.summary: Fisher & Paykel Healthcare's share price is starting to level off after rising more than 60% over the past year, following two strong halves of results.
na1ca7c8a8d.why: Fisher & Paykel Healthcare is a New Zealand medical device maker known for respiratory and surgical products sold worldwide.

nb7a9b7b1ff.headline: DWP PIP change to payments this month ahead of benefit increase next year
nb7a9b7b1ff.summary: Personal Independence Payment claimants will see their payments automatically increase next year, with the change applied to payments this month, according to the Gazette Series.
nb7a9b7b1ff.why: Personal Independence Payment is a UK disability benefit administered by the Department for Work and Pensions, and changes to benefit levels affect government spending.

n9f19e402b8.headline: Housing prices spike up to 65% in top 30 tier II cities: Report
n9f19e402b8.summary: Weighted prices of new launch projects in the top 30 tier-II Indian cities rose up to 65% between 2023 and October 2024, according to a PropEquity report.
n9f19e402b8.why: Residential property prices drive developer revenues and margins, and housing demand is a key part of India's construction-led economic growth.

n0c75e08e5d.headline: SSAB receives billions in support for the transition to fossil-free steel (update)
n0c75e08e5d.summary: Swedish steelmaker SSAB has been awarded a total of SEK 1.45 billion in support from the Swedish Agency for Economic and Regional Growth and the EU. The funds support conversion to fossil-free steel production.
n0c75e08e5d.why: SSAB is a Nordic steel producer, and its shift to fossil-free steel is a major capital investment in decarbonising heavy industry.

nd189646edd.headline: Stock market investors: Can family members operate their demat accounts using a single mobile number? Here’s what SEBI says
nd189646edd.summary: In a recent circular, SEBI mandated that brokers can upload the same mobile number or email for clients of the same family, only on written request. The rule takes effect immediately.
nd189646edd.why: SEBI is India's securities regulator, and its rules govern how brokers and investors operate demat accounts used for trading and holding shares.

n56c0561378.headline: Hyundai and Audi to Raise Car Prices Amid Rising Costs | Business
n56c0561378.summary: Hyundai will raise prices by up to Rs 25,000 from January 2025 because of higher input and logistics costs. The company says the adjustments aim to manage cost pressures while maintaining affordability.
n56c0561378.why: Hyundai Motor India is a major car maker in India, and price changes reflect its cost pressures and competitive positioning in the market.

n520d40c1ec.headline: Bank of Montreal Raises Dividend by 2.6%, Unveils Buyback
n520d40c1ec.summary: Bank of Montreal raised its quarterly dividend by 2.6% to C$1.59 from C$1.55 and set plans to buy back up to 20 million shares.
n520d40c1ec.why: Bank of Montreal is one of Canada's largest banks, and dividend increases and buybacks return capital to shareholders.

n4fafd2ef88.headline: Danske Bank cuts list rates on mortgages
n4fafd2ef88.summary: Danske Bank in Sweden is reducing list rates on mortgages with maturities between 3 months and 2 years. For 3-month mortgages, the list rate falls by 0.10 percentage points.
n4fafd2ef88.why: Danske Bank is a Nordic lender, and changes to its mortgage list rates affect borrowing costs and competition in the Swedish housing finance market.

impacts.name: Danske Bank
impacts.why: Lowering mortgage list rates changes the bank's pricing on its Swedish home loans.

n6ae97657cd.headline: Stock market update: FMCG stocks  up  as market  rises
n6ae97657cd.summary: The 30-share BSE Sensex closed up 809.53 points at 81,765.86. FMCG stocks rose as the broader market advanced.
n6ae97657cd.why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 large companies listed on India's main exchange and is the most-watched benchmark for Indian equities.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: The index closed 809.53 points higher, a broad market rally.

n6ae97657cd.why_moved: The rally was broad across the market, with FMCG stocks among the gainers as the index rose sharply.

n6b1df6c9d9.headline: France's toppled government adds to the European Union's bigger political problems
n6b1df6c9d9.summary: Political instability in France, along with the collapse of Germany's governing coalition a month earlier, could have wide-ranging consequences for the European Union. The French government was toppled.
n6b1df6c9d9.why: France and Germany are the two largest economies in the euro area, so political instability in either can affect European bond yields, the euro and investor confidence.

ne6c854bfa9.headline: Global billionaire wealth surges 17% in 2024, driven by US growth: UBS report - Invezz
ne6c854bfa9.summary: A UBS report says global billionaire wealth surged 17% in 2024, driven by growth in the United States. The findings are based on the bank's annual wealth analysis.
ne6c854bfa9.why: UBS is a Swiss global bank whose wealth research tracks high-net-worth trends that shape private banking and asset management demand. Billionaire wealth reflects equity market performance.

n32350c78a3.headline: BOJ rate hike bets retreat as traders count down to key meeting
n32350c78a3.summary: Market bets on a Bank of Japan rate hike have hardly changed despite a dovish policy board member saying he is not opposed to higher rates. Traders are counting down to the key meeting.
n32350c78a3.why: The Bank of Japan sets interest rates for Japan, and its decisions affect the yen, Japanese government bond yields and global carry trades. Rate expectations are closely watched by investors.

nc1c5826417.headline: Dollar Tree hints at price increases, product cuts if proposed tariffs go through
nc1c5826417.summary: Dollar Tree, which also owns Family Dollar, said it may raise prices and cut some products if proposed tariffs go through. It did not specify which products would be affected.
nc1c5826417.why: Dollar Tree is a US discount retailer whose margins are sensitive to import costs. Tariff changes can affect retail pricing, consumer spending and margins across the sector.

nc86f13fb87.headline: What Pat Gelsinger's Retirement Likely Means for Intel Stock
nc86f13fb87.summary: Motley Fool examines what Pat Gelsinger's retirement means for Intel stock. The article focuses on the implications for the chipmaker's shares.
nc86f13fb87.why: Intel is a major US semiconductor company that designs and makes processors. Leadership changes at a large chipmaker can affect strategy, investor confidence and its share price.

nb1692f4415.headline: President Macron says will appoint new PM in coming days
nb1692f4415.summary: President Emmanuel Macron said he would appoint a new prime minister in the coming days, with the top priority of getting a 2025 budget adopted by parliament. Michel Barnier was ousted.
nb1692f4415.why: The French prime minister leads the government that must pass the budget, and political deadlock affects French debt markets and eurozone sentiment.
nb1692f4415.why_moved: Barnier's ouster left the 2025 budget unfinished, and Macron's pledge to name a successor quickly points to a race to pass fiscal legislation.

n5c749affb3.headline: Macron tries to rebuild French govt after refusing to step down
n5c749affb3.summary: Macron rejected calls to step down and is trying to rebuild the French government. He criticised the far left and far right for trying to provoke an early presidential election.
n5c749affb3.why: France is the euro zone's second-largest economy, and political instability affects its government bonds and fiscal policy outlook.

nca5cb5fce9.headline: Why markets and the EU aren’t panicking over France’s budget mess — yet
nca5cb5fce9.summary: Prime Minister Michel Barnier warned of financial fallout if toppled, but POLITICO reports the expected market storm has not materialized so far.
nca5cb5fce9.why: France is the euro area's second-largest economy, and its public finances and political stability affect European government bond markets and the euro.

n6d581d2d10.headline: ‘China’s MicroStrategy’ Meitu sells all its Bitcoin and Ethereum: Asia Express
n6d581d2d10.summary: Chinese company Meitu has sold all of its 940 Bitcoin and 31,000 Ether. The move passes the title of largest corporate Bitcoin holder to Japan's Metaplanet, which holds 1,100 BTC.
n6d581d2d10.why: Meitu is a Xiamen-based photo-editing and consumer technology company that had built a crypto treasury. Corporate crypto holdings are watched as a signal of institutional appetite for digital assets.

na7fb10a483.headline: French government collapses in no-confidence vote - International | Daily Mirror
na7fb10a483.summary: The French government collapsed after Prime Minister Michel Barnier was ousted in a no-confidence vote. The vote followed his use of a special tool to push through an austerity budget without a parliamentary vote.
na7fb10a483.why: France is the euro area's second-largest economy, and its budget and debt path affect French government bond yields and the euro. Political instability tends to raise borrowing costs.
na7fb10a483.why_moved: The government fell in a no-confidence vote after the prime minister pushed an austerity budget through without a parliamentary vote, adding political uncertainty over fiscal policy.

n9fb527b831.headline: Ultraviolette raises Rs 130 Cr funding from Zoho, others
n9fb527b831.summary: Indian electric motorcycle maker Ultraviolette raised Rs 130 crore from Zoho and other investors, a few months after flagging off its first batch of Indian-made bikes to Europe.
n9fb527b831.why: Ultraviolette is an Indian EV maker, and funding rounds like this reflect investor appetite for electric two-wheeler companies expanding internationally.

nf02a1e5649.headline: Virgin Voyages new annual pass offers agents up to $15k commission, first cruise to enable Bitcoin payment
nf02a1e5649.summary: Virgin Voyages, the adults-only cruise line, launched a new annual pass that can be paid with Bitcoin, with agent commissions of up to $15,000.
nf02a1e5649.why: Virgin Voyages is a cruise operator, and accepting Bitcoin marks a niche test of crypto payments in the travel industry.

nd5455b97a4.headline: OPEC+ expected to extend oil supply cuts
nd5455b97a4.summary: The OPEC oil cartel and its allies are expected to extend their supply cuts. The move is aimed at avoiding a sharp drop in oil prices.
nd5455b97a4.why: OPEC+ is a group of oil-producing nations that coordinates output to influence crude prices, which affect energy costs, inflation and producer revenues worldwide.
nd5455b97a4.why_moved: Expected supply-cut extensions are intended to prevent a sharp fall in prices, according to the report.

naadc4c93c2.headline: China warns against ‘worship’ of faster growth
naadc4c93c2.summary: Chinese state media articles seek to manage expectations ahead of a key economic meeting, warning against the worship of faster growth.
naadc4c93c2.why: Official growth targets and policy signals from China's leadership influence global commodity demand and investor expectations for its economy.

nea6ecea333.headline: Macro Afternoon
nea6ecea333.summary: Asian stock markets were generally lower on macro concerns ahead of the US jobs print. The Australian dollar stayed under pressure just above the 64 US cent level, and oil futures struggled to hold gains.
nea6ecea333.why: The Australian dollar is sensitive to commodity prices and global risk sentiment, and US jobs data influence global equity and currency markets.

nff1b558c1b.headline: Excise suspends production licence of W. M. Mendis and Co. - Breaking News | Daily Mirror
nff1b558c1b.summary: The Department of Excise suspended the production licence of liquor company W. M. Mendis and Co. for evading Rs.5.5 billion in tax arrears, the Daily Mirror reported.
nff1b558c1b.why: W. M. Mendis is a major Sri Lankan liquor producer, and a licence suspension halts its production and revenue.

n9aa1ad1fff.headline: Gold flat as investors await US payrolls data
n9aa1ad1fff.summary: Gold prices were little changed on Thursday as investors awaited US payrolls data expected to provide more direction. The report is seen as a key input for rate expectations.
n9aa1ad1fff.why: Gold is a traditional store of value whose price is sensitive to US interest-rate expectations and the dollar.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold prices were flat while investors waited for the US payrolls release.

nb4d06bf7e9.headline: NVIDIA to Open Vietnam R&D Center to Bolster AI Development
nb4d06bf7e9.summary: Nvidia announced it is opening its first research and development center in Vietnam. The company said the move signals confidence in the country's artificial intelligence potential.
nb4d06bf7e9.why: Nvidia designs the GPUs that power most AI data centres, so its investment decisions shape the global AI hardware and talent market.

n41c7ec6787.headline: Poilievre offers two hours on Monday for Freeland to present fall economic statement
n41c7ec6787.summary: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre offered two hours on an opposition day so Finance Minister Chrystia Freeland can present the government's fall fiscal update in the House of Commons.
n41c7ec6787.why: The fall economic statement sets out the federal government's updated budget outlook, including spending and deficit projections.

n0e30d7b2e7.headline: The GST tax holiday is coming but will the savings actually make a difference?
n0e30d7b2e7.summary: Canada's GST tax holiday is coming, but its savings are modest, with one consumer noting it is not a huge sum of money but still helps.
n0e30d7b2e7.why: A temporary sales-tax cut affects consumer spending and retail prices in the short term.

ne5cf9228d9.headline: Govt grants Kabaza amnesty
ne5cf9228d9.summary: Malawi's Finance Minister announced the Malawi Revenue Authority will open a voluntary tax compliance window for kabaza motorcycle operators. Those smuggled into the country may register at a small fee.
ne5cf9228d9.why: The Malawi Revenue Authority collects the country's taxes, and informal transport operators are a growing part of the tax base.

ne2f3f01a46.headline: South Africa's current account deficit broadly unchanged in Q3
ne2f3f01a46.summary: South Africa's current account deficit stayed at 1.0% of GDP in the third quarter, unchanged from the second, according to central bank data. In rand terms it narrowed to R70.8 billion from R75.3 billion.
ne2f3f01a46.why: The current account balance measures trade and income flows with the rest of the world and influences the rand and capital-flow needs.

n48e7cfb72c.headline: Kwinana cobalt refinery, Australia
n48e7cfb72c.summary: Cobalt Blue Holdings is proposing to build Australia's first cobalt sulphate refinery at Kwinana. The plant would produce battery-grade cobalt sulphate for US Inflation Reduction Act and EU markets.
n48e7cfb72c.why: Cobalt sulphate is a key input for battery cathodes, so refining capacity outside China is a focus for electric vehicle supply chains.

n79f51290d9.headline: Tabaković: NBS Has 47.8 Tons of Gold
n79f51290d9.summary: Serbia's National Bank holds 47.8 tons of gold, with gross foreign exchange reserves at 28.7 billion euros, more than 2.5 times higher than in 2012 due to significant net purchases.
n79f51290d9.why: Strong foreign reserves and gold holdings enhance Serbia's financial stability and ability to manage currency and external shocks.

n5450d578e7.headline: Listed companies on the BRVM: SMB takes a nosedive
n5450d578e7.summary: SMB, a multinational bitumen producer and marketer, reported a decline in after-tax profit, impacting its listing on the BRVM stock exchange.
n5450d578e7.why: SMB is a key player in bitumen markets in West Africa; profit declines may reflect sector challenges and affect investor sentiment regionally.

n9d10f2f540.headline: iOS 18.2 Features: Everything We Know So Far About the Upcoming Update
n9d10f2f540.summary: Apple plans to release iOS 18.2, featuring significant AI enhancements for supported iPhones.
n9d10f2f540.why: Apple's software updates can influence its device sales and ecosystem engagement, impacting its revenue and stock performance.

n0ec09a6439.headline: South Korea’s crisis with Martial Law declared reveals the death agony of the capitalist system, and the need to unite the two Koreas!
n0ec09a6439.summary: President Yoon declared martial law to address North Korean threats, but it was reversed after public protests.
n0ec09a6439.why: Political instability and military tensions can affect regional markets and investor confidence in East Asia.

ncb0bf0c569.headline: FBM KLCI enters fourth day of rally as US market lifts
ncb0bf0c569.summary: The Malaysian stock index rose for the fourth consecutive day, supported by positive US market performance.
ncb0bf0c569.why: Regional equity markets often move with US market trends, affecting investor sentiment and capital flows.

ne4181bb6f6.headline: BOJ rate-hike bets retreat as traders count down to key meeting
ne4181bb6f6.summary: Market expectations of a BOJ rate hike declined after reports cast doubt on an increase at the upcoming meeting.
ne4181bb6f6.why: Expectations of monetary policy shifts influence bond markets, currency, and investor positioning in Japan.

n8187673afe.headline: Hyundai Motor hints at largest-ever shareholder returns
n8187673afe.summary: Hyundai Motor plans record dividends and stock buybacks, signaling strong financial performance and shareholder value growth.
n8187673afe.why: Automaker shareholder returns influence stock prices and investor confidence in South Korea's automotive sector.

n93944979e9.headline: Nissan boss Uchida races to save the automaker - and his job
n93944979e9.summary: Nissan's management reports worse-than-expected business conditions, prompting efforts to stabilize the company.
